issues.description: changedFiles path comparison may fail due to absolute-vs-relative shape mismatch
issues.detail: VitestGit.findChangedFiles and config.related typically return absolute paths, while isIncluded receives a filename that gets slashed and cleanUrl'd but not normalized to the same root. The membership check `this.changedFiles.includes(filename)` is a raw string compare on two data shapes that may not align across providers/platforms. Pick one canonical shape (absolute, slashed, cleaned) at the boundary and store it.

issues.description: Wrong data structure: array membership test on every isIncluded call
issues.detail: changedFiles is a string[] and isIncluded does `.includes(filename)` per file. With many files this is O(n*m), and isIncluded is on the hot path. The right data structure is a Set<string> built once in onTestRunStart. Pick the right structure and the lookup becomes self-evident: O(1) and the cache invalidation story stays the same.

issues.description: onTestRunStart hook wired in three call sites; missing one silently breaks coverage.changed
issues.detail: The new lifecycle is invoked manually after each `_testRun.start(...)` in core.ts (three places). That is exactly the kind of duplicated coupling Pike's rules warn about: the data ("run started") is being broadcast by hand. Move the call into `_testRun.start` itself, or have generateCoverage lazily resolve changedFiles. One source of truth, no fourth caller to forget.

issues.description: CLI transform duplicates yargs/boolean coercion that already exists elsewhere
issues.detail: The inline transform handling 'true'/'yes'/'false'/'no' is a small filter that probably already exists for the sibling `--changed` option. Compose with the existing helper rather than re-implementing string-to-bool here; otherwise the two options drift on accepted spellings.

issues.description: Inheritance from test.changed is implicit and asymmetric
issues.detail: resolveConfig copies `resolved.changed` into `resolved.coverage.changed` only when undefined. That is fine, but the data flow is hidden: a reader of coverage.ts must know coverage.changed may have been silently filled from test.changed, while onTestRunStart still also reads ctx.config.changed as a fallback. Pick one: either always normalize at resolve time, or always branch at use time. Two layers doing the same job is the framework smell.

issues.description: cleanUrl added to isIncluded changes cache key semantics for all callers
issues.detail: Adding cleanUrl to the cache key is a quiet behavior change unrelated to this feature: any caller passing a URL with a query string now collapses to the bare path in globCache. Probably correct, but it belongs in a separate commit with its own test, not bundled into a feature PR. Small tools doing one thing each.

review.summary: The feature is the right shape: a coverage-time filter applied to a stream of filenames. The data structure is wrong, though - changedFiles should be a Set, not an array searched on every isIncluded call. The lifecycle hook is wired through three manual call sites in core.ts, which is the kind of duplication that quietly rots; consolidate it. cleanUrl creeping into the cache key is an unrelated behavior change bundled in. Inheritance from test.changed is done in two places (resolveConfig and onTestRunStart fallback) - pick one. Otherwise small, composable, and on the right side of Pike's rules.
